skills.description: Proof-of-concept synchronous fail-closed refund gate for e-commerce AI agents (business rules v1.0). Feed it order facts (already authenticated by the caller's OMS) and a refund request; it returns allow/deny/escalate and signs every verdict (including deny) with a 5-minute, offline-verifiable Ed25519 six-field receipt over JCS(RFC8785)-canonical JSON. Zero-dependency pure-Python RFC8032 client. Any timeout, network error, HTTP 402, non-200, missing/expired/tampered receipt or verdict mismatch is treated as deny (no payout). The gate never connects to the order database and never moves money; the merchant OMS performs the final payout. Use for "should this refund be auto-paid / refund risk control / stop an AI from issuing refunds / refund decision".

skills.description: Scans code, config and cloud-function sources for plaintext secrets (API keys, AppSecrets, database passwords, private key blocks, generic secrets) and sensitive files, emitting blocking verdicts and alerts on hits. Three scan strategies: full / incremental (git diff, mtime fallback without git) / deep (base64 re-encoding, string concat, YAML-JSON nested values, rule_id=secret-leak-deep). Sensitive key files are flagged by name only and never opened. Findings, reports and alert payloads are fully desensitized (file + line + rule + evidence hash only, zero secret values on disk). commit is never blocked; git push / cloud function deploy / config save are fully blocked (CI/deploy hook templates included). Dual alert channels: host push + audit-base weekly exception TOP; alert payloads (16 columns + anomaly_type) can be pushed to an external audit base ingest in one step. Dual-channel query/export host interfaces with no UI dependency. Findings deletion goes through an undo mechanism (backup area + manifest, keep last 3, sha256 verified). Default storage %LOCALAPPDATA%\SecretGuardian with legacy-data migration. Pure Python standard library, zero third-party dependencies, 23-case self-test gate.
skills.description_zh: Scans code, config and cloud-function sources for plaintext secrets (API keys, AppSecrets, database passwords, private key blocks, generic secrets) and emits blocking verdicts plus desensitized finding records. Redaction core: scan code, not people.
skills.name: Secret Guardian (secret-guardian-en)
